name: When should I consider replacing my traditional water heater with a tankless model?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my traditional water heater with a tankless model?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your traditional water heater with a tankless model if your current unit is over 10-12 years old, frequently runs out of hot water, or is showing signs of corrosion or leakage. Upgrading to a tankless system can provide long-term energy savings and a continuous supply of hot water. CG Plumbing Solutions can help you assess the condition of your existing heater and determine if a tankless upgrade is a cost-effective choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a tankless upgrade if your current heater is old, runs out of hot water, or is leaking, to gain efficiency and continuous hot water.
